title: NSW Photo Card
summary: Learn about the NSW Photo Card, including how to apply for, replace, and use the card as a form of identification.
who_can_apply: Must be able to provide acceptable proof of identity documents

faqs.q: Who can apply for a NSW Photo Card?
faqs.a: You must be a NSW resident, aged 16 or over, and able to provide acceptable proof of identity documents.

faqs.q: How can I apply for or replace my NSW Photo Card?
faqs.a: You can apply online, or use a photo-kit form if you cannot visit a Service NSW Centre due to a medical or health condition.

faqs.q: How long is the NSW Photo Card valid for?
faqs.a: The card is valid for 5 years, or 10 years for eligible customers aged 21 and over.
